review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Keep ordinary client read contracts unchanged and make historical observation explicit at UI call sites
review.notes: Exact candidate CI exposed four legacy API assertions: unconditional observation query and malformed response shape. Preserve original assertions rather than weakening them. Review before new/changed tests. Production screens/Trace explicitly opt in; observation never grants send authority. Synthetic responses only. Follow-up review: keep TraceReader three-argument contract intact; its existing mounted regression must remain unchanged. Trace uses explicit observed_conversation metadata on the agent rather than an extra boolean argument. Ordinary/external trace routes remain identical. Review recorded before adapting the new SID009 assertions.

cases.description: Observed reads are explicit while ordinary transcript and trace contracts remain compatible
cases.setup: Actual GtmuxClient with isolated fetch; existing legacy API/history assertions unchanged. Existing SID006 API regression is updated to make its observation request explicit.
cases.action: Read ordinary and explicit opt-in recent transcripts, malformed response and 304; read ordinary pane Trace, pane Trace with explicit observed_conversation metadata and external Trace.
cases.expected: Default URLs and malformed empty result remain exactly compatible. Detail/HQ transcript call sites explicitly opt in; pane Trace opts in only when the supplied agent contains observed_conversation metadata. Preserve recent/context/cursor/conditional headers and the existing TraceReader three-argument call contract. Last-known state survives 304; verified removes restriction. External session routes retain exact identity and never receive observation fallback. Input paths unchanged; no network/session/device operations.
